'''Rice Pudding''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]].

Rice Pudding may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]], in the [[Garbage Can]] outside the saloon, or in [[the Stardrop Saloon]]'s rotating stock. One Rice Pudding may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]].

==Bundles==
Rice Pudding is not used in any [[Bundles|bundles]].

==Recipes==
Rice Pudding is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Rice Pudding is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Light Blue Striped Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt026.png|24px]]

==Quests==
One Rice Pudding may be requested by [[Blobfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 7 to 10.

==History==
